_comment: You usually do NOT need to edit this file by hand. Run 'python server.py', fill the fields in the web UI once with 'Remember on this computer' ticked, and it writes config.json for you — storing each cookie as me_cookie_enc / friend_cookie_enc, encrypted with Windows DPAPI so it is readable only by your Windows account (on Linux/macOS it is stored as plain:<value> with 0600 permissions instead). Edit by hand only if you prefer: copy this file to config.json and paste the LEETCODE_SESSION cookie from your browser (DevTools > Application > Cookies > leetcode.com) into the plaintext keys below — they still work, and get encrypted the next time the UI saves. Leave a cookie out to fetch that user in public mode (counts + last 20 solved only).
